subtasks.objective: Harden URY Order sync_order authorization and attribution so authenticated callers cannot spoof cashier, waiter, or owner fields or replace POS Invoice items without write permission.
subtasks.acceptance: sync_order derives cashier and waiter attribution from the current session and valid POS Opening Entry or server-side user assignment instead of trusting request parameters; existing POS Invoice updates call check_permission("write") before mutating invoice fields or replacing items; sync_order no longer calls invoice.db_set("owner", cashier) from caller-controlled input; new-order behavior remains compatible with existing POS flow and unauthorized invoice mutation attempts fail before item replacement.
